diagnosis.order: Each pair cycle visits all arms; odd forward, even reverse; A/B odd AB even BA, sequential fresh processes
observations: monotonic native toBuffer and quality intervals
V8 GC trace NVP and PerformanceObserver entries
diagnosis.limits: Process counters aggregate threads. GC duration is not assumed entirely stop-the-world. No per-core scheduling or worker queue timestamp unless supplied by a later native-metrics control.
diagnosis.purpose: Causal localization only; observed runs never performance acceptance

optionalNativeControl.trigger: Original/isolated contrast and GC timeline do not localize timing variation
optionalNativeControl.method: diagnostic-only toBufferWithMetrics through the same native process_and_encode; retain total/decode/ops/encode and wall-minus-total, with exact scope limits; compare hashes

ordinary.extension: Once only if any target paired median interval includes 1.15 at 20; never complete Goal on remaining uncertainty
ordinary.order: odd AB even BA; sequential fresh processes
ordinary.statistic: B/A paired median; warm median of three; seeded 913 percentile bootstrap 20000 resamples, nominal 95 percent exploratory uncertainty; preserve all ratios/min/max/MAD
ordinary.pass: All target first/warm upper intervals <=1.15 and exact output/quality contracts match
ordinary.unresolved: Continue one cause-driven finite phase in this Issue; no favorable sample selection or completed Goal

preconditions.power: AC, low-power false, thermalState 0 before each batch
preconditions.cpu: two one-second aggregate CPU idle probes >=0.60 before batch, maximum five minute finite wait; retain probes; do not discard outcomes after measurement
preconditions.threads: UV_THREADPOOL_SIZE=4; default sharp concurrency/cache and Rayon, recorded
preconditions.build: Two fresh isolated checkouts; npm ci and canonical npm run build; Rust1.88.0, SDK26.5, distinct external Cargo targets and shared download cache only

invariants: No forced GC or extra pipeline warmup
No case removal, timer narrowing, baseline reset or threshold relaxation
Causal measurement fix only after evidence; no speculative codec change
Normal confirmation uses fixed source and no diagnostic observers; all output hashes/metadata/quality gates retained
Final reviewed exact source must have full hosted CI/security/release benchmark and non-tag eight-package candidate/native twelve reports plus explicit Wasm verification or hash-bound reuse
No tag, publish, Release, deploy, deprecate, force push or branch deletion
